'''Tteek Tlek''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The crazed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eriz Vossan]] convinced Tlek and his clan to dismantle their camp's [[Sandcrawler/Legends|Sandcrawler]] and build [[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]] to fight the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] and take control of the desert and Vossan then left the Jawas, leaving only a message for a man called [[Rowan Delk]]. When Delk arrived together with a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] they [[Mission to Tatooine (Barsen'thor)|fought]] and destroyed the war droids so Tlek asked the two's help to repair the sandcrawler in exchange for the message.<ref name="TOR:LOftLG" />
